market_outlook.short_term: Highly volatile and risk-off. Oil above $100 and Iran escalation dominate. Dow -600 pts signals broad selloff. Bond yields rising on US debt fears. Expect continued chop until Iran situation clarifies. Nvidia Sept 10 event adds binary risk. ECB rate decision adds European pressure.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural concerns around US debt sustainability and trade fragmentation persist. AI capex cycle continues but governance risks emerge. Energy transition disrupted by oil shock. India and EM offer relative growth. Inflation likely sticky above 3-4% through 2027. Defense and energy structurally elevated.
